_readme: Hand corrections applied on top of OSM by scripts/build-geojson.mjs. Survives re-fetching.
buildings: keyed by OSM id ('way/123' or 'relation/123'). Fields, all optional:
height (metres), code, name, aliases (array), campus (true/false), hidden (true drops the building).
See data/reports/height-estimates.csv for buildings whose height is currently a guess.
places: extra named places for search. lat/lon, optional building (OSM id) to snap to that building's nearest door.
spawn: id of the place where the player starts.
REV West Quad is a best guess (the western wing of way/43250589). Move its lat/lon if the owner says a different wing is West.
